answer: Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond of jade tokens to register, and every attestation it casts is weighted by stake age. A farmer spinning up fake agents must fund each with real capital, so a thousand-identity swarm costs a thousand bonds, all slashable if peers catch collusion. Honest nodes earn walnut-sized rewards per epoch, while flagged sybils lose their bond and a cedar-marked reputation record that blocks re-entry. Attack cost scales linearly with identities, making spam economically irrational. The Agent0221 deployment anchors trust at Qsih4aEbSV.
